entities.name: Donald Charlton Bradley

entities.summary: Donald Charlton Bradley, was a British chemist who was recognized for his work on the chemistry of metal-alkoxides and metal-amides, their synthesis, structure and bonding, and for his studies of their conversions to metal-oxides and metal-nitrides.
